title: Q-KG-open-questions: knowledge graph of all open-questions data (DATAGRAPH-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every executor run; DATAGRAPH-1
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/knowledge-graph.json::"open-questions": \{ "state": "built"
**Status:** open

DATAGRAPH-1: open-questions runs its own Worker in ultrastable/open-questions. Map its entries with the shared engine seed/worker/src/knowledge.js (vendored, never edited), serve /api/graph and /api/graph/health from that map, then set this row to built.

**Prediction:** kg_systems_built >= 1 more within 168 h
**Out of scope:** changing the entry format or the loop.
**Closing probe:** GET https://open-questions.ultrastable.org/api/graph/health expect 200
